title: At the mountains....this place freaks me out.
content: I have only had about 5 dreams involving the snowy mountains. Two of them were great and involved my family. Both of these dreams were about having a family reunion up within the mountains. We were on one side and there was a large gap between a taller mountain range. These mountains were the ones covered in snow. On the side I was on, there was a little but nothing really serious. A walking path went up the mountain. To the right you could look down towards a river. On the left were a few buildings. A small one, a medium one and then at the end a very large one. This is the one we always go to. Once inside, the place looks straight out of China. It resembles a restaurant, but it isn't. My family has gathered here twice to have a reunion. To one side a path leads outside. The path leads up and down the mountain. I've never gone up further up. When I've tried, someone always stops me and tells me there's a place above where no man should go. That demons lurk there. So I don't go that way. But I have been there. I'll explain later. It's along this path I see people standing on the edges of the path fishing. They seem to be in peace and just having fun. There's nothing at the bottom so I just stay near the building. There's also some kind of roof above us. It appears to be a road. Like a highway built over the mountains. Now for the forbidden place. I've never traveled by foot towards the forbidden place everyone warns me about. But I seem to just spawn within this building. It resembles a Chinese restaurant. it's got two main areas with tables and seatings. There doesn't seem to be any doors or windows that can lead in and out of this place. There's some stairs on one side, behind a wall. But they lead up and then back down to the same place. Then there's an outside area. It's from here you can see mountains to one side and a clear blue sky. A few clouds. There's a small storage room here. A wall goes all around it. This is where I've seen portals open and these demonic creatures pour in. They resemble half human/half animals. Things like bulls, lizards, dogs, cats, elephants, seas creatures. They come in wearing armor and it's like they use this place to fight one another. I always hide beneath some tables in the 2nd seating area of the place. They don't really go in there that much. they stay within the main room and just mutilate each other. It's like every time one gets killed, another comes in. If they do see you, they will chase you and destroy you. I've seen it happen to others. I was found once by a lion looking one but he ignored me and instead focused on another creature that looked like a bull. When there's only one left. That one just goes back out through a portal. I then tend to explore the area safely. The storage room has always given me bad vibes and I've never been able to open the doors to see what's inside.. I don't know about anyone else, but has anyone been in a place like this? Within the mountains?
